title: Fluctuation dynamics in randomly advected Navier-Stokes equations below critical scaling
summary: We study randomly advected incompressible Navier-Stokes equations, where the advecting field is a mean-zero, divergence-free, space-time stationary velocity field with smooth order-one correlations. We introduce a two-parameter family of models in which the advection is accelerated on a fast temporal scale $\varepsilon^2$ and has spatial correlation length $δ$; the critical regime $\varepsilon = δ$ corresponds to the natural parabolic scaling of the Navier-Stokes equation.
